name: Demo Trail
description: A short practice route for trying things out.

story.birdsong: The path grows quiet except for birdsong.
story.clouds: You are walking above the clouds now.

facts.lapse-rate: Air cools by roughly 6.5 °C for every 1000 m you climb, so the summit can be winter while the valley is spring.
facts.naismith: Naismith's rule (1892) for planning hikes: an hour for every 5 km of distance, plus an hour for every 600 m of climb.

big-day.name: Big Day
big-day.description: Walk 15 km in a single day.
